title: 第六章  危机
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶落缓缓收敛下周身的气息，“好熟悉的感觉，就好像原来拥有过的一样，叶落摇摇头，不管怎么说，先将实力提升上去再说。

“沈老师，我已经突破到炼体九重了”，沈苍月此时目瞪口呆，从来没有听说过有人能一次性突破八重修为，太不可思议了。随着叶落突破完成，暗中查看目光却并没有减少太多，

天空之中一阵纯粹的灵力洒了下来，使人周身暖洋洋的，“是光明属性的异能，通过与灵力相结合”，沈苍月向叶落解释道，

忽然，叶铭面前空间一闪，一个身穿西装的中年男子出现在了他面前，“同学，我叫夜鑫，是世纪大学的校长，我能问你几个问题吗？”

“您问呗”，

“你修炼了人皇决？”

叶铭点点头，“应该吧”

“应该？你怎么连自己修炼了什么玄功都不知道，算了小家伙，你的天赋很惊人啊，虽然起步比较晚，但既然古老说了，那必然是可造之材，你抓紧时间修炼，但你修炼了人.......，算了，争取能到御灵境界吧。”

沈苍月松了一口气，还好自己布下了结界，不然还真的不这么好解释，但人皇诀还是被他察觉出来了，但倒也无所谓，毕竟曾经想要尝试修炼到第一层的人也不在少数，只是后来这些人大多都废了，终身不得寸进，若不是古青将他送入精英班，那些人或许都不会多看他一眼，不过，一次性突破八重，说不定真的可以修炼成人皇诀。

“叶落，你刚刚突破，即便根底再厚实，也得及时巩固一下，，对了，修炼室就是你的居所，里面有休息室。”

“好的，我正好再细细琢磨一下修炼的事。”

叶落先将重力器调到十挡，以他的肉身，这种级别的重力在常态下是最适合的，然后直接盘腿打坐，开始看起了识海中的其余三部经文，“青龙诀，我记得当时是有一抹青光在脊柱那边的，青龙诀竟然如此强大，一共有十变，每一变都会或得一个神技，肉身增强十倍，最后一变更是能青龙化，这不比人皇诀强？”，“长生诀，这玩意修炼了难道能长生？还有这什么九字战诀，我难道是什么牛逼的强者重生？嗯？等等我记得我也没修炼他们呀，为什么也已经达到第一重了呢？莫非？这人皇诀的功效就是实现多种法诀同时突破，这也太变态了吧，算了算了，不去想它，还是先巩固一下今日的成果吧。”

周围修炼室的同学今天晚上总感觉灵气变少了，但也找不到具体原因。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ye Luo slowly calmed down the breath around him, "It feels so familiar, as if I had it before." Ye Luo shook his head. Anyway, let's improve his strength first.

"Teacher Shen, I have broken through to the ninth level of body refining." Shen Cangyue was dumbfounded at this time. She had never heard of anyone being able to break through to the eighth level of cultivation in one go. It was incredible.As Ye Luo's breakthrough was completed, his secret inspection gaze did not decrease much.

A burst of pure spiritual power poured down from the sky, making people feel warm all over. "It is a light-attributed ability, combined with spiritual power," Shen Cangyue explained to Ye Luo,

Suddenly, the space in front of Ye Ming flashed, and a middle-aged man in a suit appeared in front of him, "Classmate, my name is Ye Xin, and I am the president of Century University. Can I ask you a few questions?"

"Just ask."

"Have you practiced the Human Emperor Art?"

Ye Ming nodded, "Probably"

"Should?How come you don’t even know what mysterious skills you have practiced? Forget it, little guy, your talent is amazing. Although you started relatively late, but as ancient times say, it must be something you can create. You should seize the time to practice, but you have cultivated people..., forget it, try to reach the realm of controlling spirits."

Shen Cangyue breathed a sigh of relief, luckily he had set up a barrier, otherwise it would not be so easy to explain, but he was still aware of the Human Emperor Technique, but it didn't matter. After all, there were many people who wanted to practice to the first level, but most of these people were disabled later and could not make any progress for life. If Gu Qing hadn't sent him to the elite class, those people might not have looked at him twice. However, if he broke through the eighth level in one go, he might really be able to practice the Adult Emperor Technique.

"Ye Luo, you have just made a breakthrough. No matter how solid your foundation is, you still need to consolidate it in time. By the way, the training room is your residence, and there is a rest room inside."

"Okay, I just want to think more about cultivation."

Ye Luo first adjusted the gravity device to the tenth gear. With his physical body, this level of gravity was the most suitable under normal conditions. Then he sat cross-legged and meditated, and began to read the other three scriptures in the sea of consciousness. "Qinglong Jue, I remember that there was a flash of green light on the spine. The Qinglong Jue is so powerful. There are ten changes in total. Each change will lead to a magical skill. The physical body is strengthened ten times. The last change is the ability to transform into a green dragon. Isn't this better than the Human Emperor Jue?"", "The Secret of Immortality, can you live forever if you practice this thing?And what about this nine-character battle formula? Am I the rebirth of some awesome strong man?Um?Wait, I remember that I haven’t cultivated them either, so why have I reached the first level?Could it be?The function of this Human Emperor Technique is to achieve breakthroughs in multiple techniques at the same time. This is too abnormal. Forget it, don't think about it, let's consolidate today's results first."

The students in the surrounding training room always felt that their spiritual energy had decreased tonight, but they could not find the specific reason.
